nonblocking_findings: SELF [tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh:29-37] The pattern '*.sh' or 'run.sh' selects run.sh as a suite. The nested runner uses the default patterns, so the run ends. SYMLINK [tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh:32] The test [ -f "$f" ] follows symbolic links. A link test_link.sh -> ../../outside.sh in the suite folder ran the file outside the folder. A user with write access to the folder is necessary. Consider [ -L "$f" ] as a skip condition.

PYGLOB [tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh:53] The runner passes a .py file name to unittest discover -p, which reads it as a glob. The suite test_[ab].py ran test_a.py instead. The plan contract (plan.md:32) prescribes this command, so the runner obeys the contract. The case needs a file name with glob characters.

MKTEMP [tests/spec_review_gate/test_s1_standard.sh:19, tests/spec_review_gate/test_s1_new_track.sh:22] With TMPDIR=/nonexistent_dir_xyz, mktemp -d fails and TMP is empty. Add a mktemp check, as test_s1_adversarial.sh does.

PYZERO [tests/spec_review_gate/run.sh:53] A .py suite with zero tests, or a .py name that discover cannot import (a hyphen or a space), gives FAIL only because Python 3.12 and later exit 5 for NO TESTS RAN. On Python 3.11 or earlier, the same suite gives a vacuous PASS. This host has Python 3.14.4.
